#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

void connect(vector<vector<int>>& grid, vector<vector<int>>& g, int i, int j, int s, int t) {
    int n = grid.size() - 1;
    int m = grid[0].size() - 1;
    if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m) return;
    g[grid[i][j]].push_back(grid[s][t]);
}

int maxMatching(vector<vector<int>>& g, int m, int n) {
    vector<int> pairU(m + 1, 0);
    vector<int> pairV(n + 1, 0);
    vector<int> dist(m + 1, 0);
    int matchCount = 0;

    auto bfs = [&]() {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
            if (pairU[u] == 0) {
                dist[u] = 0;
                q.push(u);
            } else {
                dist[u] = INT_MAX;
            }
        }
        int maxDist = INT_MAX;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (dist[u] < maxDist) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (pairV[v] == 0) {
                        maxDist = dist[u] + 1;
                    } else if (dist[pairV[v]] == INT_MAX) {
                        dist[pairV[v]] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return maxDist != INT_MAX;
    };

    function<bool(int)> dfs = [&](int u) {
        if (u != 0) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (pairV[v] == 0 || (dist[pairV[v]] == dist[u] + 1 && dfs(pairV[v]))) {
                    pairU[u] = v;
                    pairV[v] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            dist[u] = INT_MAX;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    };

    while (bfs()) {
        for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
            if (pairU[u] == 0 && dfs(u))
                matchCount++;
        }
    }
    return matchCount;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    long long totalCost = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int excessN = (n - 100) % 6;
        long long quotientN = (n - 100) / 6;
        totalCost += quotientN * 6LL * m;
        n = 100 + excessN;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int excessM = (m - 100) % 6;
        long long quotientM = (m - 100) / 6;
        totalCost += quotientM * 6LL * n;
        m = 100 + excessM;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> grid(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    int uLabel = 1;
    int vLabel = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                grid[i][j] = uLabel++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                grid[i][j] = vLabel++;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> adjList(uLabel);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i - 3, j);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i, j - 3);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i, j + 3);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i + 3, j);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                connect(grid, adjList, i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    int maxMatchCount = maxMatching(adjList, uLabel - 1, vLabel - 1);
    totalCost += 2LL * maxMatchCount;
    cout << totalCost << "\n";

    return 0;
}
